plugin.note: Wilderness Black Knights have very high melee and ranged defence (+70 to +76) but a negative magic defence (-11), so magic is by far the fastest style. Avoid melee and ranged. Bring Wilderness risk gear.

requirements: No combat, Slayer or quest requirement; assigned by Krystilia only.
Kills must occur in the Wilderness to count.
mechanics: Level 33 Wilderness Black Knights spawn south of the Bandit Camp (Lava Maze) and north-east of the Bone Yard.
Very high melee/ranged defence; magic defence is negative (-11).

methods.label: Magic
methods.summary: Blast the black knights with magic against their negative magic defence.
steps: Travel to the Wilderness Black Knight spawns south of the Bandit Camp or north-east of the Bone Yard.
Attack with magic; their magic defence is negative.
Avoid melee and ranged - both defences are very high.
notes: Take caution: this is a Wilderness PvP zone.

methods.label: Clear both spawn clusters
methods.summary: Rotate between the spawn south of the Bandit Camp (9) and the cluster north-east of the Bone Yard (7) to maintain kills.
steps: Blast the 9 black knights south of the Bandit Camp with magic.
Hop to the 7 spawns north-east of the Bone Yard while the first cluster respawns.
Continue rotating between the two clusters.
notes: Both clusters are level 33 Wilderness; watch for player killers between them.

styleOptions.label: Magic
styleOptions.summary: Magic exploits their negative magic defence (-11).
